latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generation ComfyUI.

- Generate AI-powered 1080p video clips from text prompts or images (PNG, JPG, MP4, WebM up to 200MB).
- Cloud GPU-powered rendering with no local install required; jobs complete in 1–3 minutes.
- Session-based workflow: upload, edit, preview, and export video in various formats (e.g., MP4, GIF).
- Free use with automatic anonymous token generation (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Clear workflow for uploads, credit checking, timeline state, and exports; robust error handling with user-friendly feedback.
- Built for indie creators and ComfyUI enthusiasts seeking cost-free, streamlined AI video generation.
